sessionStart.command: f="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/.i-have-adhd-always"; s="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md"; if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$s" ]; then echo 'ADHD MODE ACTIVE (always-on). The ruleset below applies to every response. "stop adhd mode" turns it off for this session; delete '"$f"' to turn always-on off for good.'; awk 'NR==1&&/^---/{h=1;next} h&&/^---/{h=0;next} !h' "$s"; fi

preToolUse.command: if command -v plannotator >/dev/null 2>&1; then plannotator improve-context; fi
if command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1; then rtk hook claude; fi

permissionRequest.command: if command -v plannotator >/dev/null 2>&1; then plannotator; fi

postToolUse.command: jq -j '(.tool_input.file_path | select(endswith(".ts") or endswith(".tsx"))) + "\u0000"' | xargs -0 -r -- tsgo --noEmit --

stop.statusMessage: Reviewing recent transcript for rule updates

stop.command: if command -v plannotator >/dev/null 2>&1; then plannotator; fi

sessionStart.command: f="$HOME/.claude/.i-have-adhd-always"; s="$HOME/.agents/skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md"; if [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$s" ]; then echo 'ADHD MODE ACTIVE (always-on). The ruleset below applies to every response. "stop adhd mode" turns it off for this session; delete '"$f"' to turn always-on off for good.'; awk 'NR==1&&/^---/{h=1;next} h&&/^---/{h=0;next} !h' "$s"; fi
